title: Moving elevators: time block transfers between lanes
summary: Elevators carry blocks between lanes on a cycle, so a clear route can close the moment a piece is lifted away.

seo.title: Block Out Moving Elevators Obstacle Guide
seo.description: Understand how Block Out moving elevators move blocks between lanes and when to use the transfer in your route.

rules: Moving elevators shift blocks from one lane to another on a repeating cycle.
A block loaded onto an elevator leaves its current lane and returns in a different lane after the cycle completes.
The App Store listing describes Block Out elevators as elements that carry pieces between lanes.
strategyPoints: Watch the elevator cycle before committing a block that depends on staying in its lane.
Use the transfer to move a stuck color toward its exit instead of forcing a longer manual route.
Stage blocks near the elevator when the next cycle clearly helps the planned order.
avoidPoints: Do not assume a block stays where you placed it once an elevator cycle starts.
Do not load a color you still need in its lane if the transfer would strand it.
Do not plan the whole route around one cycle without checking the return lane.
